headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.1
summary: Synced with upstream v1.6.1: optional microphone permission for mod developers, faster native library extraction and startup, and improved content management. We kept our lightweight WebSocket Discord RPC and the Minecraft background service instead of upstream's Discord Social SDK and removed foreground service.

items.text: Synced with upstream v1.6.1, which added optional microphone permission for proximity voice chat mods.
Synced upstream optimisations for native library extraction and caching to speed up Minecraft startup.
Synced upstream content management optimisations for faster pack imports and world list loading.
Kept our lightweight WebSocket Discord RPC and Minecraft background service, skipping upstream's Discord Social SDK switch.
Language switcher and locale handling remain fixed for Indonesian and other locales.
